The author reported at site on 25th November 2024 to carry-out the C-Inspection of GT02. 
The C- inspection work started on 25.11.2024 by the customer and their contractor" M/s 
Vasavi Power". The disassembly of the thermal block was completed by 01.12.2024.
 
Mechanical completion of the unit was done by 20.12.2024 and the Motor roll was done 
21.12.2024.
Subsequently the unit was started up successfully on 22.12.2024 by the customer.
 
•   During this outage the following work was carried out.
•   The GT vane rows-1 and 2 was replaced with re-conditioned vanes, during this C-
inspection.   
•   The inlet segments were replaced with new segments.
•   The stator heat shield- B was replaced with new heat shields.

•  All assembly materials used for re-blading of GT blades & vanes are new.
•   The GT Rotor blade rows 1 and 2 are replaced with reconditioned blades.
•   The Hot gas casing was re-used even though there was cracks on weld joints as well 
as it crossed the life time but    there was no spare HGC(customer`s decision).
•   The combustion chamber was refurbished under the supervision of HGP Specialist 
from GE.
•  The inner liner is replaced with reconditioned liner with TBC.
•  All the tile carriers and tiles (full set) were replaced with new ones.
           •  During the assembly, the radial rotor position was found in tolerance.
           •  Coupling alignment was measured and found in tolerance.
• The blow off valves were overhauled, the soft parts were replaced and leak test was 
done successfully.
• The burner was overhauled, the swirler was replaced and pressure test was done 
successfully.
• All the QA measurements were taken by the customer`s contractor(M/s Vasavi Power).
• Labyrinth seal -D was replaced partially(9 rows replaced out of 15) with new spares.

The author reported at site on 25th November 2024 to carry-out the C-Inspection of GT02. The C- inspection work started 
on 25.11.2024 by the customer and their contractor" M/s Vasavi Power". The disassembly of the thermal block was 
completed by 01.12.2024.

  The GT vane rows-1 and 2 was replaced with re-conditioned vanes, during this C-inspection.

  The inlet segments were replaced with new segments. 
 
  The stator heat shield- B was replaced with new heat shields.

 All assembly materials used for re-blading of GT blades & vanes are new.

  The combustion chamber was refurbished under the supervision of HGP Specialist from GE.

  All the tile carriers and tiles (full set) were replaced with new ones. 
•

• 
Coupling alignment was measured and found in tolerance. 
 
The blow off valves were overhauled, the soft parts were replaced and leak test was done successfully. 
 
The burner was overhauled, the swirler was replaced and pressure test was done successfully. 
 
All the QA measurements were taken by the customer`s contractor(Vasavi Power). 
 
Labyrinth seal -D was replaced partially(9 rows replaced out of 15) with new spares.

Found dirty with black deposits on vanes as well as on the casing. All compressor vanes and blades were

Action: 
All compressor vanes and blades were cleaned manually.  
 
                        All the vanes with rubbing marks are de-burred. 
 
3.3.2. Blow off Valves stages 1 ,2 and 3. 
In general, found the valves in dirty condition. 
 
Action: 
Dismantled all four valves and cleaned all the parts. Re-assembled the valves after replacing all the 
soft parts (Teflon seals, piston guides, O-ring etc.). Done leak test (with air supply) of all the valves 
and found okay. 
 
3.4. Compressor Diffuser 
The compressor diffuser inner and outer was found in good condition. 
The grooves(for HGC) on the compressor diffuser found with some heavy fretting. 
Action: 
Split line and threads were cleaned and inspected prior to assembly. All sealing surfaces, keys/keyways 
were cleaned and inspected prior to assembly. During this outage, all the entry segments and vane 
head seal segments on both the halves were replaced. 
                        The fretted area of the suspension groove on both the halves were re-built by welding and ground 
to the size as per the drawing. 
 
3.5. Rotor assembly 
 
3.6.1 Rotor 
In general, the Rotor found in good condition. The labyrinth seal D found damaged; the seal strips were broken off. 
The damaged labyrinth seal-D, partially (9 rows replaced out of 15) replaced with new seals and the height of the seal was 
ground manually and set to the height as per the drawing. 
Two blades on compressor row-1 was found with impact damages(dent on LE) and an ER case (ER-20241206-0472 )was raised 
with GE Engineering. 
GE Engineering recommended to replace the two damaged blades with new spares as the size of damage is beyond the limit 
as per the repairing criteria. But customer decided not to replace but to blend it by filing the damaged area. 
 
Action:

The damaged labyrinth seal D is replaced with new spares. 
• 
Done de-burring of the rubbed compressor blade rows. 
• 
Done cleaning of the complete rotor, compressor blades and coupling flanges. 
• 
The GT blade rows 1 replaced during the outage with reconditioned blades. 
• 
The GT blade row-2 was replaced with 106 reconditioned blades and 1 used blade with serial number FGTI887C 
(used for 16,000EOH on another unit). ER case was raised with GE Engineering and got approval to re-use that one 
blade for one cycle only(ER case ER-20241202-0877)

NDT was carried out by customer`s vendor on all GT blades and RHSS and no flaws were reported.

1. Summary 
 
The author traveled from Kerala, India to Anta, India on 27th November 2024 and started with 
the hot gas path work on 28th November 2024. 
  
 Standard disassembly and re-assembly of complete combustion chamber was done. 
 Standard dimension checks after assembly of combustion chamber. 
 All parts of the combustion chamber were cleaned.  
 Replacement of thelower combustion chamber insert with new GE supplied replacements. 
Inner liner TBC coated.  
 8 air nozzles installed in LCCI. 
 Installation of 3 new key in the lower intermediate liner was done.   
 Row1 to 5 of tiles carrier were replaced with new spare parts with spring loaded.  
 The sight glass bush of row 1 was install with new spare.  
 Inner cone was repaired and reinstalled. 
 DPT was done in the all welded area of the tiles carrier stand. 
 Lapping and retapping was done for all the old spare parts of upper casing and lower     
casing was cleaned.  
 Flame monitor bushes on inner cone pos 1 & 2 found damaged, repaired and reinstalled. 
  Repair works of burner was done as per customer instruction. 
 Took all the measurements of lower and upper combustion chamber. 
 Test certificate have been attached with this report. 
 The hot gas path specialist left the site on 21th December 2024.

3.2 Repair works of tile carrier row 1- 5 
 All the tiles in row 1 – 5 of Tiles carrier were TBC coated.  
 Row1 to 5 of tiles carrier were replaced with new spare parts with spring loaded. 
 New modification tiles & tile carrier were installed on the old tile carrier stand.  
 Note: the old tile stand was used as suggested by customer, since new stand had to 
installed with 6 new bushes. 
 New tile carrier row 5 collar joint to LCCI collar didn’t had sufficient clearance. So all 
around the collar was cut at 200.0mm, re-welded & tested with DPT. these was done in 
consultation with customer. 
 Tile carrier row-1 sight glass wasn’t functioning, so as instructed by customer that was 
blinded. Customer didn’t had any spare available.  
 New model seal ring - tile carrier row1 installed on inner cone. 
 2 tiles installed in row 5 sight glass position were new. 
 Note – Old sight glass is not functioning properly. Customer was advised to install new 
sight glass. 
 
Repair works of Upper Cone 
 
 Flame monitor bushes on inner cone position 1&2 found damaged. These were cut, weld 
repaired & installed in correct position. The weld joints were NDT tested.  
 Lapping and retapping was done for all the old spare parts and were cleaned. 
 DPT was done on all weld joints in Inner cone and it was in good condition. 
 Upper Cone and Inner cone were disassembled, cleaned, lapped and reinstalled. The 
moving function is satisfactory. 
 
Repair works of Upper Casing 
 
 The old spare parts were lapped, tapped, cleaned and reinstalled on the lower casing.  
 Note – Flame monitor should be cleaned and reinstalled by the customer (instrument     
group).   
 
Repair works of Burner 
 
 Repair works of burner was done as per customer instruction. 
 DPT was done on all the weld joints and were found satisfactory. 
 Inner ring (GMD0881047P0001) of the dual gas burner was replaced with new ring. 
 Outer ring (GMD5881066P0001) of the dual gas burner was replaced with new ring. 
 All spare parts of dual gas burner were cleaned and reinstalled. 
 Pressure test of dual gas burner was done by customer.
